decision_question: Can this version be distributed as supervised public source in AskJamie Resume Representative?
acceptance_criteria: Portable package and license, with a clear route and filing record
Source preserves person, purpose, authority, access, opening identity, and version boundaries
Synthetic cases cover consequential failure modes and a valid first save
Bounded claims and required protected-main checks before integration
source_basis: Owner-authorized career filing workflow abstracted without private workspace data
Current AskJamie Resume Representative companion skills and Skillz LinkedIn drafting and publication-operations boundaries
The frozen public package, author-visible cases, and conditional Equilibrium review

shared_model_or_source_limits: Codex evidence, outcome, safety-portability, disruptor, and negotiator roles used separate prompts and shared public package inputs. Shared model family can correlate judgments.
Independent source inspection and a mock interleaving exercise do not demonstrate host execution.

initial_reviews.finding: An earlier posting key can describe the same requisition, and basename exclusivity cannot prevent a second folder for a logical opening.
The same provider account can hold two people with the same requisition. Reuse without a verified person scope can route to the wrong person.
Unresolved coverage can make a visible match nonunique. Shared link lookup must preserve grants and account identity.

concordance: Initial materially different release positions triggered negotiation and skipped disruption. Three separate rereviews agreed after corrections. A conditional disruptor then reproduced a retargeting race and the final adjudication checked the narrow repair.

development_history.cause: Person and purpose, alias crosswalk, coverage, and authority controls were incomplete.
Conditional falsification reproduced an alias retarget after the final lookup.

claim_ledger.claim: A verified person and purpose constrain every opening match.
claim_ledger.consequence: A matching requisition can otherwise route the artifact to a different person.
claim_ledger.next_test: Run shared-account synthetic fixtures through an authorized host.

claim_ledger.claim: Alias crosswalk, complete relevant identity evidence, and shared logical-key protection govern duplicate prevention.
claim_ledger.consequence: A legitimate folder can be duplicated or a noncanonical folder reused.
claim_ledger.next_test: Exercise competing supported writers and both provisional and exact keys.

claim_ledger.claim: Writing binds the verified destination and checks access before saving content. Readback proves parent identity and payload independently of cloud metadata.
claim_ledger.consequence: A payload could be saved to a wrong or over-shared folder and reported as verified.
claim_ledger.next_test: Run identity-bound writes and changed-permission cases in an authorized sandbox.

claim_ledger.claim: The package carries 17 author-visible development cases and 21 discovery designs.
claim_ledger.consequence: Treating these cases as live or protected would overstate readiness.
claim_ledger.next_test: Supply an unseen external holdout and run matched evaluation.

falsification_hypotheses: A verified shortcut can retarget before exclusive creation.
A newly created child can have broader access than its checked parent.

test_results.resolution: In-memory interleaving reproduced the wrong-folder write with a mutable path. The modeled stable-identity create left the unintended folder empty. Final source requires identity binding, scope and access protection, and expected-parent readback.
Source verifies actual child access before payload. A development case records a created folder and a blocked artifact separately.

decisive_evidence: Final version closes represented-person and purpose mismatch, uncertain crosswalk, partial inventory, unsafe link resolution, and competing logical names.
Final instructions block mutable-locator-only writes and require expected-parent and payload readback.
The synthetic review supports source distribution with plan fallback.
unresolved_items: Protected-main validation and integration are tracked by the release PR.
Host guard enforcement, automatic discovery, and comparative quality are unverified.

limitations: Supervised source only. No live filing or connector operations were run.
Matched benchmark, host activation and unseen release holdout are not-run. The in-memory test exercises a model of a race and cannot certify a host.
Material changes to the frozen source or to access and write assumptions require renewed review.

follow_up.condition: Before claiming host compatibility or measured uplift, freeze the same-version protocol and execute an authorized sandbox and unseen holdout.
